product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides AI-powered eDiscovery and investigation software for law firms, corporate legal departments, and legal service providers.
product_one_liner.notes: Reveal describes its AI-powered eDiscovery and investigation platform and explicitly names law firms, corporate legal departments and service providers as its users. Sources: https://www.revealdata.com/about-us and https://www.revealdata.com/news/reveal-data-launches-19th-worldwide-data-center

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URLs are demo/contact landing pages, not public plan listings. Generic pay-as-you-go/subscription language does not identify plans, and the homepage navigation directs visitors to demonstrations rather than pricing. Sources: https://revealdata.com/pricing, https://www.revealdata.com/request-pricing and https://www.revealdata.com/

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Reveal publishes customer success stories describing Premier Legal Technologies' and Paradigm's use of its software. Sources: https://www.revealdata.com/success-stories/premier-legal-technologies-uses-reveal-ai-to-find-thousands-of-docs-hidden-from-human-review and https://www.revealdata.com/success-stories/how-paradigm-used-reveal | named_customers.0: The success story explicitly describes Premier Legal Technologies using Reveal AI. Source: https://www.revealdata.com/success-stories/premier-legal-technologies-uses-reveal-ai-to-find-thousands-of-docs-hidden-from-human-review | named_customers.1: The customer success story is titled “Paradigm Uses Reveal to Dramatically Increase Review Efficiency & Accuracy.” Source: https://www.revealdata.com/success-stories/how-paradigm-used-reveal

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn count of 478 falls within 201-500. The official website gives a rounded 500+ figure, so headcount estimates differ. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/reveal-data and https://www.revealdata.com/about-us

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official About page gives Chicago as the location of its North American headquarters. Source: https://www.revealdata.com/about-us | hq_country: The official About page identifies its North American headquarters as Chicago, USA. Source: https://www.revealdata.com/about-us

founded_year.notes: Reveal explicitly states that it was founded in 2008. Source: https://www.revealdata.com/news/reveal-data-launches-19th-worldwide-data-center

eng_blog.notes: The blog describes itself as guidance on using eDiscovery technology. Its visible index contains legal-workflow, deployment, AI-adoption and buying guidance, rather than two engineer-authored posts explaining how Reveal is built. Source: https://www.revealdata.com/blog

public_docs.notes: The support page links public documentation for Reveal, Discovery Manager, Reveal Hold, Logikcull and other products; multiple documentation articles are accessible. Source: https://www.revealdata.com/support

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-position list contains support, strategy, collections, full-stack engineering and sales roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Source: https://jobs.jobvite.com/reveal

model_provider.notes: Official documentation explicitly says COSMIC models can be created using mBERT or High Precision Classification. This establishes supported model technology, not Reveal's default generative-AI provider. Source: https://review-help.revealdata.com/en/Reveal-AI-Model-Library.html

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR. HIPAA is linked only as a report, without an explicit compliance claim, so it is excluded; PCI DSS is not listed. Source: https://security.revealdata.com/ | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 Type 2 is explicitly listed. Source: https://security.revealdata.com/ | compliance_certs.1: ISO/IEC 27001 is explicitly listed. Source: https://security.revealdata.com/ | compliance_certs.2: GDPR appears in the compliance listing. Source: https://security.revealdata.com/

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The current public company profile identifies the latest deal type as Debt - Acquisition. Its date and amount are not publicly visible. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/91843-93 | funding_date: The public financing table does not disclose the latest acquisition-debt transaction's date, so no YYYY-MM value can be established. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/91843-93 | funding_amount_usd: The latest financing is identified as acquisition debt, but its amount is unavailable in the public profile. Older equity amounts and the value of acquisitions cannot safely substitute for that financing amount. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/91843-93

raised_18mo.notes: Funding history is established, but the latest acquisition-debt financing is undated in the public profile. Its occurrence within the 18-month window therefore cannot be determined without guessing. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/91843-93

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive, II posting has an application link and is listed on the company's open-position board. Source: https://jobs.jobvite.com/reveal/job/oAdJAfwQ

launched_6mo.notes: Reveal introduced its agentic Reveal AI suite on August 24, 2026, within the six months preceding November 9, 2026. Source: https://www.revealdata.com/blog/reveal-introduces-reveal-ai-agentic-ediscovery-from-preservation-to-case-development

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The verified CEO transition was announced October 14, 2025, outside the requested window. A complete dated leadership roster was unavailable, so neither a qualifying recent change nor a reliable negative could be established. Source: https://www.revealdata.com/news/wendell-jisa-transitions-to-chairman-of-reveals-board-of-directors-and-announces-new-ceo
